defect: the asynchronous stream crossing cannot be judged because the FIFO adapter is a behaviorally unspecified black box
rationale: Both clocks and all stream timing are declared, but the implementation behind the adapter stub is absent. Its buffering, synchronizer, reset, and ready/valid preservation behavior are therefore undecidable from this design.

mutation.description: Replaced the source asynchronous FIFO adapter with an explicit stub to model an unavailable implementation.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced AXI stream ports to one byte and retained only the unspecified dual-clock adapter boundary.
